name: rivora
description: Find, read and build from the feature plans your team approved in Rivora, and send suggestions back for review.

interface.longDescription:
Rivora is an AI system for product teams. It helps you design a complete solution for each feature, and learns your decisions, code, rules and clarifications along the way. Your team checks every part.

When a feature's solution is approved, Rivora freezes it into a handoff with a version pin. This plugin lets you find that handoff by the feature's name, read every approved part, see the sources each part used, and check the open questions before anyone starts building. Coding agents get the approved plan, so they build what your team confirmed instead of guessing.

If something in the approved plan looks wrong, the assistant can send a suggestion back. It appears on the feature for a person to review. The plugin never changes an approved part.

You sign in with your Rivora account and choose the workspace. The assistant reads approved handoffs in that workspace only. Drafts never leave Rivora. You can see and end each connection in Rivora under Settings, Integrations, Agent access.

Rivora is in early access. A Rivora account is needed.
capabilities: Find an approved feature handoff by feature and product name
Read every approved part of a handoff
List the questions still open on a handoff
Show the sources and evidence behind a requirement
Send a suggested change back for a person to review
defaultPrompt: Find the Rivora handoff for digital statements for members and summarise it.
Which open questions on the digital statements handoff block the backend work?
Build the frontend part of the approved digital statements handoff in this repo.

positive.description: Find a handoff by feature name
positive.prompt: Find the Rivora handoff for digital statements for members.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the feature Digital statements for members, the product Member Portal and the version pin of the latest approved handoff.

positive.prompt: Summarise the approved plan for digital statements for members.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the handoff overview and its approved parts, then gives a short summary of what was agreed, with the version pin.

positive.prompt: What questions are still open on the digital statements handoff?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the questions still unanswered (about 48 on the demo, all nice to confirm). Questions already answered are not listed.

positive.prompt: Show me the backend part of the digital statements handoff.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Backend / Platform Specification exactly as approved.

positive.description: Find the source behind a requirement
positive.prompt: Where did the requirement about NSW members come from in the digital statements handoff?
positive.expected_behavior: Cites the business rule 'NSW members on legacy policies keep paper statements' and the recorded consent decision.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Sydney today?
Write a short poem about autumn leaves.

publication.release_notes: First release. Find, read and check approved Rivora handoffs, and send suggestions back for review.
